_doc: Case Packs (gen/imposter_gen.py --packs). Each pack has `cases` cases of 6 rounds; themes rotate like a season. Pools are pack-<id>-<key>. Only packs whose cases are all generated and approved (--pack-approve) are built into the site. `free` is shown in the UI; the server limit is FREE_PACK_CASES in lib/packs.js.

packs.name: Wildlife

packs.style: Candid snapshot taken from a few metres away at a zoo, farm, beach or home, the whole animal in frame, anatomically accurate for its species, not looking into the lens, not cute, not a portrait, not symmetrical, muted natural colours, cluttered ordinary background, not cartoon, not 3D render, not illustration.
